'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Matt Sokol DS Walker Garrison (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sokol]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Walker Garrison (V) (Dark)|VB6-D-walkergarrison-pre.gif|label=Walker Garrison (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
